WITH spend_rows AS (
  -- one row per exported spend row, each set of copies once, on its UTC day
  SELECT DISTINCT spend_date, campaign_id, impressions, clicks, spend, currency, export_timezone,
         CASE WHEN export_timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN spend_date + 1 ELSE spend_date END AS utc_day
  FROM ad_spend_daily
),
spend_months AS (
  -- one row per UTC month of 2025: the spend in euros
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', s.utc_day) AS DATE) AS month_start,
         SUM(CASE WHEN s.currency = 'EUR' THEN s.spend ELSE s.spend * f.eur_per_unit END) AS spend_eur
  FROM spend_rows AS s
  LEFT JOIN fx_rates_monthly AS f
    ON f.currency = s.currency
   AND f.month = CAST(date_trunc('month', s.utc_day) AS DATE)
  WHERE s.utc_day >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND s.utc_day < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', s.utc_day) AS DATE)
),
exported AS (
  -- one row per month of spend_date: the spend as exported
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', spend_date) AS DATE) AS month_start,
         SUM(spend) AS spend_as_exported
  FROM ad_spend_daily
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', spend_date) AS DATE)
),
revenue AS (
  -- one row per UTC month: the payments that were not refunded
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', paid_at) AS DATE) AS month_start,
         SUM(amount_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM payments
  WHERE NOT refunded
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', paid_at) AS DATE)
),
months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025 with spend
  SELECT m.month_start, e.spend_as_exported, m.spend_eur, COALESCE(r.revenue_eur, 0) AS revenue_eur
  FROM spend_months AS m
  LEFT JOIN exported AS e ON e.month_start = m.month_start
  LEFT JOIN revenue AS r ON r.month_start = m.month_start
)
-- one row per month of 2025 with spend
SELECT month_start,
       spend_as_exported,
       spend_eur,
       revenue_eur,
       ROUND(revenue_eur / spend_eur, 2) AS roas,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
             / SUM(spend_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS ytd_roas
FROM months
ORDER BY month_start

WITH spend_rows AS (
  -- one row per set of matching exported rows, with its UTC day
  SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN export_timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN spend_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY ELSE spend_date END AS DATE) AS utc_day,
         currency, spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily
  GROUP BY spend_date, campaign_id, impressions, clicks, spend, currency, export_timezone
),
converted AS (
  -- one row per spend row of 2025, in euros
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', r.utc_day) AS DATE) AS month_start,
         r.spend * COALESCE(f.eur_per_unit, 1) AS spend_eur
  FROM spend_rows AS r
  LEFT JOIN fx_rates_monthly AS f
    ON f.currency = r.currency
   AND f.month = CAST(date_trunc('month', r.utc_day) AS DATE)
  WHERE r.utc_day BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
monthly AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025 with spend
  SELECT month_start, SUM(spend_eur) AS spend_eur
  FROM converted
  GROUP BY month_start
),
paid AS (
  -- one row per UTC month: revenue without the refunded payments
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', paid_at) AS DATE) AS month_start,
         SUM(CASE WHEN refunded THEN 0 ELSE amount_eur END) AS revenue_eur
  FROM payments
  GROUP BY 1
),
exported AS (
  -- one row per month of spend_date: the spend as exported
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', spend_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, SUM(spend) AS spend_as_exported
  FROM ad_spend_daily
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.month_start,
       e.spend_as_exported,
       m.spend_eur,
       COALESCE(p.revenue_eur, 0) AS revenue_eur,
       ROUND(COALESCE(p.revenue_eur, 0) / m.spend_eur, 2) AS roas,
       ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.revenue_eur, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY m.month_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
             / SUM(m.spend_eur) OVER (ORDER BY m.month_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS ytd_roas
FROM monthly AS m
LEFT JOIN exported AS e ON e.month_start = m.month_start
LEFT JOIN paid AS p ON p.month_start = m.month_start
ORDER BY m.month_start

WITH rates AS (
  -- one row per month and currency, euros included at a rate of 1
  SELECT month, currency, eur_per_unit
  FROM fx_rates_monthly
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT month, 'EUR', 1
  FROM fx_rates_monthly
),
spend_rows AS (
  -- one row per exported spend row, each set of copies once, on its UTC day
  SELECT DISTINCT spend_date, campaign_id, impressions, clicks, spend, currency, export_timezone,
         CASE WHEN export_timezone = 'UTC' THEN spend_date ELSE spend_date + 1 END AS utc_day
  FROM ad_spend_daily
),
spend_months AS (
  -- one row per UTC month of 2025: the spend in euros
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', s.utc_day) AS DATE) AS month_start, SUM(s.spend * r.eur_per_unit) AS spend_eur
  FROM spend_rows AS s
  JOIN rates AS r
    ON r.currency = s.currency
   AND r.month = CAST(date_trunc('month', s.utc_day) AS DATE)
  WHERE year(s.utc_day) = 2025
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', s.utc_day) AS DATE)
),
running AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025 with spend, with the sums from the first month on
  SELECT m.month_start,
         (SELECT SUM(a.spend) FROM ad_spend_daily AS a WHERE CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) = m.month_start) AS spend_as_exported,
         m.spend_eur,
         COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_eur) FROM payments AS p
                   WHERE p.refunded = false AND CAST(date_trunc('month', p.paid_at) AS DATE) = m.month_start), 0) AS revenue_eur
  FROM spend_months AS m
),
totals AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025 with spend, with its year-to-date sums
  SELECT month_start, spend_as_exported, spend_eur, revenue_eur,
         SUM(revenue_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS revenue_ytd,
         SUM(spend_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS spend_ytd
  FROM running
)
SELECT month_start, spend_as_exported, spend_eur, revenue_eur,
       ROUND(revenue_eur / spend_eur, 2) AS roas,
       ROUND(revenue_ytd / spend_ytd, 2) AS ytd_roas
FROM totals
ORDER BY month_start

WITH u AS (
 SELECT s.*, CASE WHEN export_timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN spend_date + 1 ELSE spend_date END AS utc_day
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM ad_spend_daily) s
), e AS (
 SELECT u.utc_day, date_trunc('month', u.utc_day)::DATE AS mth,
  CASE WHEN u.currency = 'EUR' THEN u.spend ELSE u.spend * f.eur_per_unit END AS eur
 FROM u LEFT JOIN fx_rates_monthly f ON f.currency = u.currency AND CAST(f.month AS DATE) = date_trunc('month', u.utc_day)::DATE
 WHERE u.utc_day >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND u.utc_day <= DATE '2025-12-31'
), r AS (
 SELECT date_trunc('month', paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::DATE AS mth, SUM(amount_eur) AS rev
 FROM payments WHERE NOT refunded AND CAST(paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND CAST(paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE) <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1
),
x AS (
 SELECT date_trunc('month', spend_date)::DATE AS mth, SUM(spend) AS exported FROM ad_spend_daily GROUP BY 1
), m AS (
 SELECT e.mth AS month_start, SUM(e.eur) AS spend_eur, MAX(x.exported) AS spend_as_exported, COALESCE(MAX(r.rev), 0) AS revenue_eur
 FROM e LEFT JOIN x ON x.mth = e.mth LEFT JOIN r ON r.mth = e.mth GROUP BY e.mth
)
SELECT month_start, spend_as_exported, spend_eur, revenue_eur,
 ROUND(revenue_eur / spend_eur, 2) AS roas,
 ROUND(SUM(revenue_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) / SUM(spend_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month_start), 2) AS ytd_roas
FROM m ORDER BY month_start
